```{=html}
<style>
  :root {
    --app-blue: #2fa2db;
    --app-blue-dark: #1f8fc7;
    --tab-gray: #d9d9d9;
    --panel-border: #8d8d8d;
    --button-yellow: #f5c555;

    --legend-lift: 68px;
    --ink: #1d1d1d;

    --paper: #ffffff;

  }

  body {
    margin: 0;

  main.content,

  }

  .sampling-app {

  }

  .app-topbar {

  .app-title {

  }

  .tab-strip {

  }

  .tab-btn.active {

  }

  .tab-panel {

  }

  .tab-panel.active {

  }

  .instructions h2 {

  }

  .instructions {

  }

  .instructions p {

    max-width: none;
  }

  .workspace {
    display: grid;
    width: min(100%, 980px);
    margin: 18px auto 0;
    grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr);
    column-gap: 24px;
    row-gap: 0;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .size-panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding-top: 58px;
    transform: translateY(calc(-1.5 * var(--sample-button-height)));
  }

  .size-panel h3 {
    margin: var(--sample-shift) 0 calc(var(--sample-button-height) / 3);

    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;

  .size-buttons {

    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .size-btn {

    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;

  .size-btn:hover,

    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  .size-footnote {

    flex-wrap: nowrap;

  .m-control {

  }

  .toolbar-actions {

  }

  #m-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
  #m-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .parameter-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    border: 2px solid #bababa;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3d3d3d;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .parameter-toggle input {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .toggle-check {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 2px solid #efc7d6;
    background: #ffffff;
    position: relative;
    flex: none;
  }

  .parameter-toggle input:checked + .toggle-check::after {
    content: "✓";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: #DA5A86;
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .toggle-copy {
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .toggle-copy small {
    display: block;

    color: #7d7d7d;
  }

  .chart-card {

    min-height: 472px;
  }

  #means-chart {
    display: block;

    height: 472px;
  }

  .chart-frame {

  .row-guide {

  .sample-dot {

  .sample-dot.is-hovered {

  .population-line {

  }

  .axis-line {

  }

  .axis-tick {

  .sample-hover-tooltip {

  .sample-hover-tooltip.visible {

  .sample-hover-tooltip .tooltip-row {

        <div class="instructions">
          <h2>Instrucciones</h2>
          <p>
            Haga click en los botones de la sección “tamaño muestral” para observar cómo
            varían los promedios de un número determinado de muestras tomados de manera
            aleatoria de una población.
          </p>
          <p>
            Puede cambiar el número total de muestras, por default se considera un conjunto
            de 30 muestras. Cada círculo gris representa el promedio de una muestra y el
            círculo negro corresponde al promedio de todos los promedios muestrales para un
            tamaño muestral fijo.

<script>
  const SAMPLE_SIZES = [3, 10, 30, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000];
  const DOMAIN_MIN = 39;
  const DOMAIN_MAX = 46;
  const POPULATION_MEAN = 42.9;
  const POPULATION_SD = 2.25;
  const CASES_STORAGE_KEY = "tlc-simulacion-casos-v1";
  const SHOW_MEAN_STORAGE_KEY = "tlc-simulacion-mostrar-promedio-v1";

  const state = {
    activeTab: "grandes-numeros",
    selectedN: null,
    m: 30,
    rowResults: new Map(),
    cases: [],
    showPopulationMean: true,
    hoveredSample: null
  };

  const RANDOM_COLORS = {
    population: "#DA5A86",
    sample: "#30b8a2",
    barFill: "#e6e6e6",
    barStroke: "#a5abb1",
    axis: "#676d72",
    miniMean: "#8fc8e4"
  };

  const randomSamplingState = {
    sampleSize: 30,
    numSamples: 40,
    populationMean: 42,
    populationSd: 12,
    autoSpeed: 8,
    samples: [],
    sampleMeans: [],
    pooledMean: null,
    pooledSd: null,
    autoTimer: null
  };

  const ciState = {
    populationMean: 30,
    populationSd: 12,
    distributionType: "normal",
    sampleSize: 30,
    numSamples: 40,
    confidenceLevel: 95,
    useSampleSd: false,
    populationValues: [],
    sampleRecords: [],
    autoTimer: null,
    hoveredRecordIndex: null
  };

  function randn() {
    let u = 0;
    let v = 0;
    while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
    while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  function average(values) {
    if (!values.length) return 0;
    return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length;
  }

  function standardDeviation(values) {
    if (values.length < 2) return 0;
    const mean = average(values);
    const variance = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2, 0) / values.length;
    return Math.sqrt(variance);
  }

  function sampleStandardDeviation(values) {
    if (values.length < 2) return 0;
    const mean = average(values);
    const variance = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2, 0) / (values.length - 1);
    return Math.sqrt(variance);
  }

  function clamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
  }

  function normalizeM(rawValue) {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(rawValue, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 1) {
      return 30;
    }
    return parsed;
  }

  function stableJitter(index, sampleSize) {
    const seed = Math.sin((index + 1) * 12.9898 + sampleSize * 0.031) * 43758.5453;
    return (seed - Math.floor(seed)) - 0.5;
  }

  function simulateSampleMean(sampleSize) {
    const sd = POPULATION_SD / Math.sqrt(sampleSize);
    const value = POPULATION_MEAN + randn() * sd;
    return clamp(value, DOMAIN_MIN - 0.35, DOMAIN_MAX + 0.35);
  }

  function simulateSampleSummary(sampleSize, sampleNumber) {
    const sampleValues = Array.from(
      { length: sampleSize },
      () => sampleNormal(POPULATION_MEAN, POPULATION_SD)
    );
    const mean = clamp(average(sampleValues), DOMAIN_MIN - 0.35, DOMAIN_MAX + 0.35);
    const sd = sampleStandardDeviation(sampleValues);

    return {
      sampleNumber,
      sampleSize,
      mean: Number(mean.toFixed(4)),
      sd: Number(sd.toFixed(4))
    };
  }

  function makeCase(sampleSize, m) {
    const sampleStats = Array.from(
      { length: m },
      (_, index) => simulateSampleSummary(sampleSize, index + 1)
    );
    const means = sampleStats.map((sampleItem) => sampleItem.mean);
    const grandMean = Number(average(means).toFixed(4));
    const maxCaseNumber = state.cases.reduce((max, caseItem) => Math.max(max, caseItem.caseNumber || 0), 0);

    return {
      id: (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID)
        ? window.crypto.randomUUID()
        : `case-${Date.now()}-${sampleSize}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
      caseNumber: maxCaseNumber + 1,
      sampleSize,
      numSamples: m,
      means,
      sampleStats,
      grandMean,
      populationMean: POPULATION_MEAN,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      populationLineVisible: state.showPopulationMean
    };
  }

  function saveCases() {
    localStorage.setItem(CASES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state.cases));
  }

  function loadState() {
    try {
      const storedCases = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CASES_STORAGE_KEY) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(storedCases)) {
        state.cases = storedCases;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      state.cases = [];
    }

    const storedShowMean = localStorage.getItem(SHOW_MEAN_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (storedShowMean !== null) {
      state.showPopulationMean = storedShowMean === "true";
    }

    let nextNumber = 1;
    let casesChanged = false;
    [...state.cases].reverse().forEach((caseItem) => {
      if (!caseItem.caseNumber) {
        caseItem.caseNumber = nextNumber;
        casesChanged = true;
      }
      nextNumber = Math.max(nextNumber, (caseItem.caseNumber || 0) + 1);
      if (typeof caseItem.populationLineVisible !== "boolean") {
        caseItem.populationLineVisible = true;
        casesChanged = true;
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(caseItem.sampleStats) && Array.isArray(caseItem.means)) {
        caseItem.sampleStats = caseItem.means.map((meanValue, meanIndex) => ({
          sampleNumber: meanIndex + 1,
          sampleSize: caseItem.sampleSize,
          mean: meanValue,
          sd: null
        }));
        casesChanged = true;
      }
    });
    if (casesChanged) {
      saveCases();
    }

    state.rowResults = new Map();
    state.selectedN = null;
  }

  function renderButtons() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".size-btn").forEach((button) => {
      const buttonN = Number.parseInt(button.dataset.sampleSize, 10);
      button.classList.toggle("is-selected", state.selectedN === buttonN);
    });
  }

  function renderMeanToggle() {
    const toggle = document.getElementById("population-mean-toggle");
    toggle.checked = state.showPopulationMean;
  }

  function getRowCenters(plotHeight, plotTop) {
    const buttonArea = document.querySelector(".size-buttons");
    const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".size-btn"));

    if (!buttonArea || buttons.length !== SAMPLE_SIZES.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const areaRect = buttonArea.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!areaRect.height) {
      return null;
    }

    const centers = buttons.map((button) => {
      const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.top + rect.height / 2 - areaRect.top;
    });

    const firstCenter = centers[0];
    const lastCenter = centers[centers.length - 1];
    const innerTop = plotTop + 10;
    const innerHeight = Math.max(1, plotHeight - 20);

    return centers.map((center) => {
      const t = lastCenter === firstCenter ? 0.5 : clamp((center - firstCenter) / (lastCenter - firstCenter), 0, 1);
      return innerTop + t * innerHeight;
    });
  }

  function renderChart() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("means-chart");
    const width = 760;
    const height = 472;
    const margin = { top: 22, right: 18, bottom: 42, left: 18 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const fallbackRowGap = plotHeight / SAMPLE_SIZES.length;
    const rowCenters = getRowCenters(plotHeight, margin.top) || SAMPLE_SIZES.map((_, rowIndex) => margin.top + fallbackRowGap * (rowIndex + 0.5));
    const rowGap = rowCenters.length > 1
      ? average(rowCenters.slice(1).map((y, index) => y - rowCenters[index]))
      : fallbackRowGap;
    const xScale = (value) => {
      const t = (value - DOMAIN_MIN) / (DOMAIN_MAX - DOMAIN_MIN);
      return margin.left + clamp(t, 0, 1) * plotWidth;
    };

    const pieces = [
      `<rect class="chart-frame" x="${margin.left}" y="${margin.top}" width="${plotWidth}" height="${plotHeight}"></rect>`
    ];

    if (state.showPopulationMean) {
      const meanX = xScale(POPULATION_MEAN);
      pieces.push(
        `<line class="population-line" x1="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${(margin.top + 2).toFixed(2)}" x2="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(height - margin.bottom).toFixed(2)}"></line>`
      );
    }

    SAMPLE_SIZES.forEach((sampleSize, rowIndex) => {
      const y = rowCenters[rowIndex];
      pieces.push(
        `<line class="row-guide" x1="${margin.left}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}"></line>`
      );

      const rowData = state.rowResults.get(sampleSize);
      if (!rowData) return;

      rowData.means.forEach((meanValue, meanIndex) => {
        const jitter = stableJitter(meanIndex, sampleSize) * Math.min(18, rowGap * 0.28);
        const isHovered = Boolean(
          state.hoveredSample
          && state.hoveredSample.sampleSize === sampleSize
          && state.hoveredSample.sampleIndex === meanIndex
        );
        pieces.push(
          `<circle class="sample-dot hoverable${isHovered ? " is-hovered" : ""}" data-sample-size="${sampleSize}" data-sample-index="${meanIndex}" cx="${xScale(meanValue).toFixed(2)}" cy="${(y + jitter).toFixed(2)}" r="7.2"></circle>`
        );
      });

      pieces.push(
        `<circle class="grand-dot" cx="${xScale(rowData.grandMean).toFixed(2)}" cy="${y.toFixed(2)}" r="10.6"></circle>`
      );
    });

    pieces.push(
      `<line class="axis-line" x1="${margin.left}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}"></line>`
    );

    for (let tick = DOMAIN_MIN; tick <= DOMAIN_MAX; tick += 1) {
      const x = xScale(tick);
      pieces.push(`<line class="axis-tick" x1="${x}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" x2="${x}" y2="${height - margin.bottom + 7}"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text class="axis-label" x="${x}" y="${height - 12}" text-anchor="middle">${tick}</text>`);
    }

    if (!state.rowResults.size) {
      pieces.push(
        `<text class="empty-chart-note" x="${width / 2}" y="${height / 2 - 10}" text-anchor="middle">Seleccione un tamaño muestral para comenzar</text>`
      );
    }

    svg.innerHTML = pieces.join("");
  }

  function setHoveredSample(sampleSize, sampleIndex) {
    const nextHover = Number.isInteger(sampleSize) && Number.isInteger(sampleIndex)
      ? { sampleSize, sampleIndex }
      : null;

    const current = state.hoveredSample;
    if (
      (!current && !nextHover)
      || (
        current
        && nextHover
        && current.sampleSize === nextHover.sampleSize
        && current.sampleIndex === nextHover.sampleIndex
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    state.hoveredSample = nextHover;
    renderChart();
  }

  function positionSampleTooltip(event) {
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("sample-hover-tooltip");
    if (!tooltip) return;
    const tooltipWidth = tooltip.offsetWidth || 200;
    const tooltipHeight = tooltip.offsetHeight || 90;
    let left = event.clientX + 14;
    let top = event.clientY + 14;

    if (left + tooltipWidth > window.innerWidth - 12) {
      left = event.clientX - tooltipWidth - 14;
    }

    if (top + tooltipHeight > window.innerHeight - 12) {
      top = event.clientY - tooltipHeight - 14;
    }

    tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(12, left)}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(12, top)}px`;
  }

  function showSampleTooltip(event, sampleSize, sampleIndex) {
    const rowData = state.rowResults.get(sampleSize);
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("sample-hover-tooltip");
    const sampleMeta = rowData?.sampleStats?.[sampleIndex];
    if (!rowData || !tooltip || !sampleMeta) return;

    tooltip.innerHTML = [
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Muestra número:</strong> ${sampleMeta.sampleNumber}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Tamaño muestral:</strong> ${sampleMeta.sampleSize}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Promedio:</strong> ${formatStat(sampleMeta.mean, 2)}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Desv. estándar:</strong> ${sampleMeta.sd === null ? "-" : formatStat(sampleMeta.sd, 2)}</div>`
    ].join("");
    tooltip.classList.add("visible");
    tooltip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    positionSampleTooltip(event);
  }

  function hideSampleTooltip() {
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("sample-hover-tooltip");
    if (!tooltip) return;
    tooltip.classList.remove("visible");
    tooltip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  }

  function hideSampleHover(shouldRender = true) {
    hideSampleTooltip();
    if (!state.hoveredSample) return;
    state.hoveredSample = null;
    if (shouldRender) {
      renderChart();
    }
  }

  function handleSampleChartPointerMove(event) {
    const target = event.target && typeof event.target.closest === "function"
      ? event.target.closest(".sample-dot.hoverable[data-sample-size][data-sample-index]")
      : null;

    if (!target) {
      hideSampleHover();
      return;
    }

    const sampleSize = Number(target.dataset.sampleSize);
    const sampleIndex = Number(target.dataset.sampleIndex);
    setHoveredSample(sampleSize, sampleIndex);
    showSampleTooltip(event, sampleSize, sampleIndex);
  }

  function setActiveTab(tabId) {
    if (tabId !== "muestreos-aleatorios") {
      stopRandomSamplingAuto();
    }
    if (tabId !== "analisis-dispersion-1") {
      stopConfidenceAuto();
    }

    state.activeTab = tabId;

    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.tab === tabId);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab-panel]").forEach((panel) => {
      panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.tabPanel === tabId);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-sidebar-panel]").forEach((panel) => {
      panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.sidebarPanel === tabId);
    });
  }

  function normalizeRandomInteger(rawValue, fallback, min, max) {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(rawValue, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;
    return clamp(parsed, min, max);
  }

  function formatStat(value, digits = 2) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
    return String(Number(value.toFixed(digits)));
  }

  function getAxisDigits(minValue, maxValue, divisions) {
    const step = Math.abs(maxValue - minValue) / Math.max(1, divisions);
    if (step >= 5) return 0;
    if (step >= 1) return 1;
    return 2;
  }

  const CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY = "Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif";
  const CI_AXIS_FONT_SIZE = 10.5;
  const CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR = "#5f5f5f";

  function getFrequencyAxisStep(maxFrequency) {
    if (maxFrequency <= 15) return 1;
    if (maxFrequency <= 30) return 2;
    if (maxFrequency <= 60) return 5;
    return 10;
  }

  function getRandomPopulationDomain() {
    const halfRange = Math.max(10, randomSamplingState.populationSd * 1.9);
    const min = randomSamplingState.populationMean - halfRange;
    const max = randomSamplingState.populationMean + halfRange;
    const pad = Math.max(1.5, (max - min) * 0.03);
    return [min - pad, max + pad];
  }

  function getRandomMeansDomain() {
    const values = randomSamplingState.sampleMeans;
    const meanSd = randomSamplingState.populationSd / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, randomSamplingState.sampleSize));
    const observedMin = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : randomSamplingState.populationMean - meanSd * 3;
    const observedMax = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : randomSamplingState.populationMean + meanSd * 3;
    const min = Math.min(observedMin, randomSamplingState.populationMean - meanSd * 3.6, randomSamplingState.pooledMean ?? randomSamplingState.populationMean);
    const max = Math.max(observedMax, randomSamplingState.populationMean + meanSd * 3.6, randomSamplingState.pooledMean ?? randomSamplingState.populationMean);
    const pad = Math.max(0.35, (max - min) * 0.08);
    return [min - pad, max + pad];
  }

  function buildHistogram(values, binCount, minValue, maxValue) {
    const counts = new Array(binCount).fill(0);
    const span = Math.max(1e-9, maxValue - minValue);

    values.forEach((value) => {
      const scaled = (value - minValue) / span;
      const index = clamp(Math.floor(scaled * binCount), 0, binCount - 1);
      counts[index] += 1;
    });

    return counts;
  }

  function sampleNormal(mean, sd) {
    return mean + randn() * sd;
  }

  function readRandomSamplingControls() {
    randomSamplingState.sampleSize = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("random-sample-size").value, 30, 2, 500);
    randomSamplingState.numSamples = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("random-num-samples").value, 40, 10, 500);
    randomSamplingState.populationMean = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("random-pop-mean").value, 42, -200, 200);
    randomSamplingState.populationSd = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("random-pop-sd").value, 12, 1, 80);
    randomSamplingState.autoSpeed = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("random-auto-speed").value, 8, 1, 40);
  }

  function syncRandomSamplingControls() {
    document.getElementById("random-sample-size").value = randomSamplingState.sampleSize;
    document.getElementById("random-num-samples").value = randomSamplingState.numSamples;
    document.getElementById("random-pop-mean").value = randomSamplingState.populationMean;
    document.getElementById("random-pop-sd").value = randomSamplingState.populationSd;
    document.getElementById("random-auto-speed").value = randomSamplingState.autoSpeed;
  }

  function updateRandomSamplingSummary() {
    if (!randomSamplingState.sampleMeans.length) {
      randomSamplingState.pooledMean = null;
      randomSamplingState.pooledSd = null;
      return;
    }

    randomSamplingState.pooledMean = average(randomSamplingState.sampleMeans);
    randomSamplingState.pooledSd = sampleStandardDeviation(randomSamplingState.sampleMeans);
  }

  function appendRandomSamplingSample() {
    readRandomSamplingControls();
    syncRandomSamplingControls();

    if (randomSamplingState.sampleMeans.length >= randomSamplingState.numSamples) {
      stopRandomSamplingAuto();
      renderRandomSamplingButtons();
      return false;
    }

    const sampleValues = Array.from(
      { length: randomSamplingState.sampleSize },
      () => sampleNormal(randomSamplingState.populationMean, randomSamplingState.populationSd)
    );

    randomSamplingState.samples.push(sampleValues);
    randomSamplingState.sampleMeans.push(average(sampleValues));
    updateRandomSamplingSummary();

    renderRandomSampleGrid();
    renderRandomMeansChart();
    renderRandomSamplingButtons();
    return true;
  }

  function resetRandomSamplingSimulation() {
    stopRandomSamplingAuto();
    randomSamplingState.samples = [];
    randomSamplingState.sampleMeans = [];
    randomSamplingState.pooledMean = null;
    randomSamplingState.pooledSd = null;
    renderRandomSampleGrid();
    renderRandomMeansChart();
    renderRandomSamplingButtons();
  }

  function renderRandomSamplingButtons() {
    const onceButton = document.getElementById("random-run-once");
    const autoButton = document.getElementById("random-run-auto");
    const stopButton = document.getElementById("random-stop-auto");
    const counter = document.getElementById("random-sample-counter");
    const totalSamples = randomSamplingState.sampleMeans.length;
    const isRunning = Boolean(randomSamplingState.autoTimer);
    const atCapacity = totalSamples >= randomSamplingState.numSamples;
    onceButton.disabled = atCapacity;
    autoButton.disabled = atCapacity;
    autoButton.classList.toggle("is-running", isRunning);
    stopButton.disabled = !isRunning;
    counter.textContent = `Muestras acumuladas: ${totalSamples} / ${randomSamplingState.numSamples} | Velocidad: ${randomSamplingState.autoSpeed}/s`;
  }

  function buildMiniHistogramSvg(values, minDomain, maxDomain) {
    const width = 164;
    const height = 104;
    const margin = { top: 6, right: 4, bottom: 16, left: 18 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const binCount = 10;
    const counts = buildHistogram(values, binCount, minDomain, maxDomain);
    const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...counts);
    const span = Math.max(1e-9, maxDomain - minDomain);
    const xScale = (value) => margin.left + ((value - minDomain) / span) * plotWidth;
    const binWidth = plotWidth / binCount;
    const pieces = [
      `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#5f666b" stroke-width="1"></line>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${margin.left + plotWidth}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#5f666b" stroke-width="1"></line>`
    ];

    counts.forEach((count, index) => {
      const barHeight = (count / maxCount) * (plotHeight - 4);
      const x = margin.left + index * binWidth + 1;
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - barHeight;
      pieces.push(
        `<rect x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${y.toFixed(2)}" width="${Math.max(1, binWidth - 2).toFixed(2)}" height="${barHeight.toFixed(2)}" fill="#e7e7e7" stroke="#9aa1a7" stroke-width="0.8"></rect>`
      );
    });

    const sampleMean = average(values);
    const meanX = xScale(sampleMean);
    pieces.push(
      `<line x1="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top + 1}" x2="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.miniMean}" stroke-width="2"></line>`
    );

    const ticks = 4;
    for (let tickIndex = 0; tickIndex <= ticks; tickIndex += 1) {
      const tickValue = minDomain + ((maxDomain - minDomain) * tickIndex) / ticks;
      const x = margin.left + (plotWidth * tickIndex) / ticks;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${x.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${x.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(margin.top + plotHeight + 4).toFixed(2)}" stroke="#5f666b" stroke-width="0.8"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${height - 3}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7.5" fill="#5f666b">${formatStat(tickValue, 0)}</text>`);
    }

    return `<svg class="sample-mini-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">${pieces.join("")}</svg>`;
  }

  function renderRandomSampleGrid() {
    const container = document.getElementById("random-sample-grid");
    const samplesToShow = randomSamplingState.samples.slice(-10);

    container.innerHTML = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => {
      const sampleValues = samplesToShow[index];
      if (!sampleValues) {
        return '<div class="sample-mini-slot"><svg class="sample-mini-svg" viewBox="0 0 164 104" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="0" y="0" width="164" height="104" fill="#ffffff"></rect></svg></div>';
      }

      const [minDomain, maxDomain] = getRandomPopulationDomain();
      const svg = sampleValues
        ? buildMiniHistogramSvg(sampleValues, minDomain, maxDomain)
        : `<svg class="sample-mini-svg" viewBox="0 0 164 104" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="0" y="0" width="164" height="104" fill="#ffffff"></rect></svg>`;
      return `<div class="sample-mini-slot">${svg}</div>`;
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderRandomMeansChart() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("random-means-chart");
    const summary = document.getElementById("random-summary");
    const width = 760;
    const height = 286;
    const margin = { top: 14, right: 20, bottom: 30, left: 44 };
    const summarySpace = 160;
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right - summarySpace;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const values = randomSamplingState.sampleMeans;

    if (!values.length) {
      svg.innerHTML = `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>`;
      summary.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    const [minDomain, maxDomain] = getRandomMeansDomain();
    const binCount = Math.max(8, Math.min(12, Math.round(Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, values.length))) + 2));
    const counts = buildHistogram(values, binCount, minDomain, maxDomain);
    const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...counts);
    const span = Math.max(1e-9, maxDomain - minDomain);
    const xScale = (value) => margin.left + ((value - minDomain) / span) * plotWidth;
    const barWidth = plotWidth / binCount;
    const pieces = [
      `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.axis}" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${margin.left + plotWidth}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.axis}" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`
    ];

    counts.forEach((count, index) => {
      const barHeight = (count / maxCount) * (plotHeight - 4);
      const x = margin.left + index * barWidth + 1.5;
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - barHeight;
      pieces.push(
        `<rect x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${y.toFixed(2)}" width="${Math.max(1, barWidth - 3).toFixed(2)}" height="${barHeight.toFixed(2)}" fill="${RANDOM_COLORS.barFill}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.barStroke}" stroke-width="1"></rect>`
      );
    });

    const popLineX = xScale(randomSamplingState.populationMean);
    const sampleLineX = xScale(randomSamplingState.pooledMean ?? randomSamplingState.populationMean);
    pieces.push(`<line x1="${popLineX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${popLineX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.population}" stroke-width="3"></line>`);
    pieces.push(`<line x1="${sampleLineX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${sampleLineX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.sample}" stroke-width="3"></line>`);

    const xTicks = 8;
    for (let tickIndex = 0; tickIndex <= xTicks; tickIndex += 1) {
      const tickValue = minDomain + ((maxDomain - minDomain) * tickIndex) / xTicks;
      const x = margin.left + (plotWidth * tickIndex) / xTicks;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${x.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${x.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(margin.top + plotHeight + 6).toFixed(2)}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.axis}" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="${RANDOM_COLORS.axis}">${formatStat(tickValue, 0)}</text>`);
    }

    const yTicks = 4;
    for (let tickIndex = 0; tickIndex <= yTicks; tickIndex += 1) {
      const tickValue = (maxCount * tickIndex) / yTicks;
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - (plotHeight * tickIndex) / yTicks;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${(margin.left - 5).toFixed(2)}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}" stroke="${RANDOM_COLORS.axis}" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${(margin.left - 8).toFixed(2)}" y="${(y + 4).toFixed(2)}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="${RANDOM_COLORS.axis}">${formatStat(tickValue, 0)}</text>`);
    }

    svg.innerHTML = pieces.join("");
    summary.innerHTML = [
      `<div class="population">Promedio poblacional = ${formatStat(randomSamplingState.populationMean, 0)}</div>`,
      `<div class="population">Desv Estan. poblacional = ${formatStat(randomSamplingState.populationSd, 1)}</div>`,
      `<div class="sample">Desv Estan. muestral = ${formatStat(randomSamplingState.pooledSd ?? 0, 2)}</div>`,
      `<div class="sample">Promedio muestral = ${formatStat(randomSamplingState.pooledMean ?? 0, 2)}</div>`
    ].join("");
  }

  function stopRandomSamplingAuto() {
    if (randomSamplingState.autoTimer) {
      window.clearInterval(randomSamplingState.autoTimer);
      randomSamplingState.autoTimer = null;
    }
    if (document.getElementById("random-run-auto")) {
      renderRandomSamplingButtons();
    }
  }

  function scheduleRandomSamplingAuto() {
    if (randomSamplingState.autoTimer) {
      window.clearInterval(randomSamplingState.autoTimer);
    }

    const intervalMs = Math.max(30, Math.round(1000 / randomSamplingState.autoSpeed));
    randomSamplingState.autoTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
      const appended = appendRandomSamplingSample();
      if (!appended) {
        stopRandomSamplingAuto();
      }
    }, intervalMs);
  }

  function startRandomSamplingAuto() {
    stopRandomSamplingAuto();
    readRandomSamplingControls();
    syncRandomSamplingControls();
    if (randomSamplingState.sampleMeans.length >= randomSamplingState.numSamples) {
      renderRandomSamplingButtons();
      return;
    }

    appendRandomSamplingSample();
    scheduleRandomSamplingAuto();
    renderRandomSamplingButtons();
  }

  function initializeRandomSamplingTab() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-config-step]").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const input = document.getElementById(button.dataset.configTarget);
        const fallback = Number.parseInt(input.value, 10) || 0;
        const nextValue = fallback + Number.parseInt(button.dataset.configStep, 10);
        input.value = nextValue;
        readRandomSamplingControls();
        syncRandomSamplingControls();
        if (randomSamplingState.autoTimer) {
          scheduleRandomSamplingAuto();
        }
        renderRandomSamplingButtons();
      });
    });

    [
      ["random-sample-size", 30, 2, 500],
      ["random-num-samples", 40, 10, 500],
      ["random-pop-mean", 42, -200, 200],
      ["random-pop-sd", 12, 1, 80],
      ["random-auto-speed", 8, 1, 40]
    ].forEach(([id, fallback, min, max]) => {
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        event.target.value = normalizeRandomInteger(event.target.value, fallback, min, max);
        readRandomSamplingControls();
        syncRandomSamplingControls();
        if (randomSamplingState.autoTimer) {
          scheduleRandomSamplingAuto();
        }
        renderRandomSamplingButtons();
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("random-run-once").addEventListener("click", () => {
      stopRandomSamplingAuto();
      appendRandomSamplingSample();
    });
    document.getElementById("random-run-auto").addEventListener("click", startRandomSamplingAuto);
    document.getElementById("random-stop-auto").addEventListener("click", stopRandomSamplingAuto);
    document.getElementById("random-clear-all").addEventListener("click", resetRandomSamplingSimulation);

    syncRandomSamplingControls();
    renderRandomSampleGrid();
    renderRandomMeansChart();
    renderRandomSamplingButtons();
  }

  function inverseNormalCDF(probability) {
    if (probability <= 0 || probability >= 1) {
      return 0;
    }

    const a = [-39.6968302866538, 220.946098424521, -275.928510446969, 138.357751867269, -30.6647980661472, 2.50662827745924];
    const b = [-54.4760987982241, 161.585836858041, -155.698979859887, 66.8013118877197, -13.2806815528857];
    const c = [-0.00778489400243029, -0.322396458041136, -2.40075827716184, -2.54973253934373, 4.37466414146497, 2.93816398269878];
    const d = [0.00778469570904146, 0.32246712907004, 2.445134137143, 3.75440866190742];
    const low = 0.02425;
    const high = 1 - low;

    if (probability < low) {
      const q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(probability));
      return (((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q + c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
    }

    if (probability > high) {
      const q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - probability));
      return -(((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q + c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
    }

    const q = probability - 0.5;
    const r = q * q;
    return (((((a[0] * r + a[1]) * r + a[2]) * r + a[3]) * r + a[4]) * r + a[5]) * q /
      (((((b[0] * r + b[1]) * r + b[2]) * r + b[3]) * r + b[4]) * r + 1);
  }

  function getZCritical(confidenceLevel) {
    const alpha = 1 - confidenceLevel / 100;
    return inverseNormalCDF(1 - alpha / 2);
  }

  function readConfidenceControls() {
    ciState.populationMean = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("ci-pop-mean").value, 30, -200, 200);
    ciState.populationSd = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("ci-pop-sd").value, 12, 1, 80);
    ciState.distributionType = document.getElementById("ci-distribution-type").value || "normal";
    ciState.sampleSize = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("ci-sample-size").value, 30, 2, 500);
    ciState.numSamples = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("ci-num-samples").value, 40, 1, 400);
    ciState.confidenceLevel = normalizeRandomInteger(document.getElementById("ci-confidence-level").value, 95, 80, 99);
    ciState.useSampleSd = Boolean(document.getElementById("ci-use-sample-sd").checked);
  }

  function syncConfidenceControls() {
    document.getElementById("ci-pop-mean").value = ciState.populationMean;
    document.getElementById("ci-pop-sd").value = ciState.populationSd;
    document.getElementById("ci-distribution-type").value = ciState.distributionType;
    document.getElementById("ci-sample-size").value = ciState.sampleSize;
    document.getElementById("ci-num-samples").value = ciState.numSamples;
    document.getElementById("ci-confidence-level").value = ciState.confidenceLevel;
    document.getElementById("ci-use-sample-sd").checked = ciState.useSampleSd;
  }

  function sampleConfidencePopulationValue() {
    switch (ciState.distributionType) {
      case "rectangular": {
        const radius = Math.sqrt(3) * ciState.populationSd;
        return ciState.populationMean + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * radius;
      }
      case "triangular": {
        const radius = Math.sqrt(6) * ciState.populationSd;
        return ciState.populationMean + (Math.random() + Math.random() - 1) * radius;
      }
      case "normal":
      default:
        return ciState.populationMean + randn() * ciState.populationSd;
    }
  }

  function getConfidencePopulationDomain() {
    let halfRange = ciState.populationSd * 4;
    if (ciState.distributionType === "rectangular") {
      halfRange = Math.sqrt(3) * ciState.populationSd;
    } else if (ciState.distributionType === "triangular") {
      halfRange = Math.sqrt(6) * ciState.populationSd;
    }

    const pad = Math.max(1.5, halfRange * 0.08);
    return [Math.max(0, ciState.populationMean - halfRange - pad), ciState.populationMean + halfRange + pad];
  }

  function getConfidenceSampleDomain() {
    const theoreticalSe = ciState.populationSd / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, ciState.sampleSize));
    const values = ciState.sampleRecords.flatMap((record) => [record.mean, record.ciLow, record.ciHigh]);
    const observedMin = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : ciState.populationMean - theoreticalSe * 3.5;
    const observedMax = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : ciState.populationMean + theoreticalSe * 3.5;
    const min = Math.min(observedMin, ciState.populationMean - theoreticalSe * 3.8);
    const max = Math.max(observedMax, ciState.populationMean + theoreticalSe * 3.8);
    const pad = Math.max(0.25, (max - min) * 0.08);
    return [Math.max(0, min - pad), max + pad];
  }

  function generateConfidencePopulationValues() {
    ciState.populationValues = Array.from({ length: 7000 }, () => sampleConfidencePopulationValue());
  }

  function renderConfidenceStatus() {
    const runOnce = document.getElementById("ci-run-once");
    const runAuto = document.getElementById("ci-run-auto");
    const stopAuto = document.getElementById("ci-stop-auto");
    const status = document.getElementById("ci-status");
    const total = ciState.sampleRecords.length;
    const atCapacity = total >= ciState.numSamples;
    runOnce.disabled = atCapacity;
    runAuto.disabled = atCapacity;
    stopAuto.disabled = !ciState.autoTimer;
    status.textContent = `Muestras acumuladas: ${total} / ${ciState.numSamples}`;
  }

  function renderConfidencePopulationChart() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("ci-population-chart");
    const width = 760;
    const height = 286;
    const margin = { top: 14, right: 16, bottom: 30, left: 38 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const [minDomain, maxDomain] = getConfidencePopulationDomain();
    const binCount = 16;
    const counts = buildHistogram(ciState.populationValues, binCount, minDomain, maxDomain);
    const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...counts);
    const xScale = (value) => margin.left + ((value - minDomain) / (maxDomain - minDomain)) * plotWidth;
    const barWidth = plotWidth / binCount;
    const pieces = [
      `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${margin.left + plotWidth}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`
    ];

    counts.forEach((count, index) => {
      const heightRatio = count / maxCount;
      const barHeight = heightRatio * (plotHeight - 4);
      const x = margin.left + index * barWidth + 1;
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - barHeight;
      pieces.push(`<rect x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${y.toFixed(2)}" width="${Math.max(1, barWidth - 2).toFixed(2)}" height="${barHeight.toFixed(2)}" fill="#e6e6e6" stroke="#a2a8ae" stroke-width="1"></rect>`);
    });

    for (let tickIndex = 0; tickIndex <= 8; tickIndex += 1) {
      const tickValue = minDomain + ((maxDomain - minDomain) * tickIndex) / 8;
      const x = margin.left + (plotWidth * tickIndex) / 8;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${x.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${x.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(margin.top + plotHeight + 5).toFixed(2)}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${CI_AXIS_FONT_SIZE}" font-family="${CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY}" fill="${CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR}">${formatStat(tickValue, 0)}</text>`);
    }

    for (let tickIndex = 0; tickIndex <= 5; tickIndex += 1) {
      const ratio = tickIndex / 5;
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - plotHeight * ratio;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${(margin.left - 4).toFixed(2)}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${(margin.left - 7).toFixed(2)}" y="${(y + 4).toFixed(2)}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${CI_AXIS_FONT_SIZE}" font-family="${CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY}" fill="${CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR}">${ratio.toFixed(1)}</text>`);
    }

    svg.innerHTML = pieces.join("");
  }

  function renderConfidenceMeansChart() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("ci-means-hist-chart");
    const width = 760;
    const height = 225;
    const margin = { top: 18, right: 16, bottom: 34, left: 42 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const values = ciState.sampleRecords.map((record) => record.mean);
    const [rawMinDomain, rawMaxDomain] = getConfidenceSampleDomain();
    const minDomain = Math.floor(rawMinDomain);
    const maxDomain = Math.ceil(rawMaxDomain);
    const binCount = Math.max(1, maxDomain - minDomain);
    const counts = buildHistogram(values, binCount, minDomain, maxDomain);
    const yAxisMax = Math.max(10, ...counts);
    const boxWidth = plotWidth / binCount;
    const boxHeight = plotHeight / yAxisMax;
    const domainSpan = Math.max(1, maxDomain - minDomain);
    const xTickFontSize = domainSpan > 18 ? 8.5 : 10.5;
    const yTickStep = getFrequencyAxisStep(yAxisMax);
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    svg.style.aspectRatio = "";
    const pieces = [
      `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${margin.left + plotWidth}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`
    ];

    const binStacks = Array.from({ length: binCount }, () => []);
    ciState.sampleRecords.forEach((record, recordIndex) => {
      const scaled = (record.mean - minDomain) / Math.max(1e-9, domainSpan);
      const binIndex = clamp(Math.floor(scaled * binCount), 0, binCount - 1);
      binStacks[binIndex].push(recordIndex);
    });

    for (let binIndex = 0; binIndex < binCount; binIndex += 1) {
      const x = margin.left + binIndex * boxWidth;
      for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < yAxisMax; rowIndex += 1) {
        const y = margin.top + plotHeight - (rowIndex + 1) * boxHeight;
        const recordIndex = binStacks[binIndex][rowIndex];
        const filled = Number.isInteger(recordIndex);
        const isHovered = recordIndex === ciState.hoveredRecordIndex;
        pieces.push(
          `<rect class="${filled ? "ci-mean-cell" : ""}" ${filled ? `data-record-index="${recordIndex}"` : ""} x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${y.toFixed(2)}" width="${boxWidth.toFixed(2)}" height="${boxHeight.toFixed(2)}" fill="${isHovered ? "#1f1f1f" : filled ? "#e6e6e6" : "#ffffff"}" stroke="${isHovered ? "#111111" : filled ? "#b7bec4" : "#dadfe3"}" stroke-width="${isHovered ? 1.1 : 0.8}" shape-rendering="crispEdges"></rect>`
        );
      }
    }

    for (let tickValue = minDomain; tickValue <= maxDomain; tickValue += 1) {
      const x = margin.left + ((tickValue - minDomain) / domainSpan) * plotWidth;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${x.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${x.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(margin.top + plotHeight + 5).toFixed(2)}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${xTickFontSize}" font-family="${CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY}" fill="${CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR}">${tickValue}</text>`);
    }

    for (let tickValue = 0; tickValue <= yAxisMax; tickValue += yTickStep) {
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - (plotHeight * tickValue) / yAxisMax;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${(margin.left - 4).toFixed(2)}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${(margin.left - 7).toFixed(2)}" y="${(y + 4).toFixed(2)}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${CI_AXIS_FONT_SIZE}" font-family="${CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY}" fill="${CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR}">${tickValue}</text>`);
    }

    if (yAxisMax % yTickStep !== 0) {
      const y = margin.top;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${(margin.left - 4).toFixed(2)}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${(margin.left - 7).toFixed(2)}" y="${(y + 4).toFixed(2)}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${CI_AXIS_FONT_SIZE}" font-family="${CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY}" fill="${CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR}">${yAxisMax}</text>`);
    }

    svg.innerHTML = pieces.join("");
  }

  function renderConfidenceIntervalChart() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("ci-interval-chart");
    const width = 760;
    const height = 510;
    const margin = { top: 16, right: 16, bottom: 34, left: 18 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const [minDomain, maxDomain] = getConfidenceSampleDomain();
    const span = Math.max(1e-9, maxDomain - minDomain);
    const xScale = (value) => margin.left + ((value - minDomain) / span) * plotWidth;
    const records = ciState.sampleRecords;
    const rowGap = records.length ? plotHeight / records.length : plotHeight;
    const pieces = [
      `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>`,
      `<line x1="${xScale(ciState.populationMean).toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${xScale(ciState.populationMean).toFixed(2)}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#DA5A86" stroke-width="3"></line>`,
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${margin.left + plotWidth}" y2="${margin.top + plotHeight}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1.1"></line>`
    ];

    records.forEach((record, index) => {
      const y = margin.top + rowGap * (index + 0.5);
      const isHovered = index === ciState.hoveredRecordIndex;
      const color = isHovered ? "#151515" : record.containsMean ? "#5aaceb" : "#8f8f8f";
      const lowX = xScale(record.ciLow);
      const highX = xScale(record.ciHigh);
      const meanX = xScale(record.mean);
      pieces.push(`<g class="ci-interval-record" data-record-index="${index}">`);
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${lowX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${highX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="${isHovered ? 3.2 : 2.2}"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${lowX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${(y - 5).toFixed(2)}" x2="${lowX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(y + 5).toFixed(2)}" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="${isHovered ? 2.6 : 2}"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${highX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${(y - 5).toFixed(2)}" x2="${highX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(y + 5).toFixed(2)}" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="${isHovered ? 2.6 : 2}"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<circle cx="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" cy="${y.toFixed(2)}" r="${isHovered ? 5.8 : 4.5}" fill="${color}"></circle>`);
      pieces.push(`</g>`);
    });

    for (let tickIndex = 0; tickIndex <= 8; tickIndex += 1) {
      const tickValue = minDomain + ((maxDomain - minDomain) * tickIndex) / 8;
      const x = margin.left + (plotWidth * tickIndex) / 8;
      pieces.push(`<line x1="${x.toFixed(2)}" y1="${margin.top + plotHeight}" x2="${x.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(margin.top + plotHeight + 6).toFixed(2)}" stroke="#626262" stroke-width="1"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${CI_AXIS_FONT_SIZE}" font-family="${CI_AXIS_FONT_FAMILY}" fill="${CI_AXIS_TEXT_COLOR}">${formatStat(tickValue, 0)}</text>`);
    }

    svg.innerHTML = pieces.join("");
  }

  function stopConfidenceAuto() {
    if (ciState.autoTimer) {
      window.clearInterval(ciState.autoTimer);
      ciState.autoTimer = null;
    }
    if (document.getElementById("ci-run-once")) {
      renderConfidenceStatus();
    }
  }

  function resetConfidenceSamples(stopAuto = true) {
    if (stopAuto) {
      stopConfidenceAuto();
    }
    hideConfidenceHover(false);
    ciState.sampleRecords = [];
    renderConfidenceMeansChart();
    renderConfidenceIntervalChart();
    renderConfidenceStatus();
  }

  function refreshConfidencePopulation(resetSamples = true) {
    readConfidenceControls();
    syncConfidenceControls();
    generateConfidencePopulationValues();
    renderConfidencePopulationChart();
    if (resetSamples) {
      resetConfidenceSamples();
    }
  }

  function appendConfidenceSample() {
    readConfidenceControls();
    syncConfidenceControls();

    if (ciState.sampleRecords.length >= ciState.numSamples) {
      stopConfidenceAuto();
      renderConfidenceStatus();
      return false;
    }

    const values = Array.from({ length: ciState.sampleSize }, () => sampleConfidencePopulationValue());
    const mean = average(values);
    const sd = sampleStandardDeviation(values);
    const zValue = getZCritical(ciState.confidenceLevel);
    const theoreticalStandardError = ciState.populationSd / Math.sqrt(ciState.sampleSize);
    const samplingDistributionSd = theoreticalStandardError;
    const scaleSd = ciState.useSampleSd ? sd : ciState.populationSd;
    const standardError = scaleSd / Math.sqrt(ciState.sampleSize);
    const margin = zValue * standardError;
    const ciLow = mean - margin;
    const ciHigh = mean + margin;

    hideConfidenceHover(false);
    ciState.sampleRecords.push({
      mean,
      sampleSd: sd,
      standardError,
      useSampleSd: ciState.useSampleSd,
      populationMean: ciState.populationMean,
      populationSd: ciState.populationSd,
      sampleSize: ciState.sampleSize,
      theoreticalStandardError,
      samplingDistributionSd,
      ciLow,
      ciHigh,
      containsMean: ciLow <= ciState.populationMean && ciState.populationMean <= ciHigh
    });

    renderConfidenceMeansChart();
    renderConfidenceIntervalChart();
    renderConfidenceStatus();
    return true;
  }

  function startConfidenceAuto() {
    stopConfidenceAuto();
    readConfidenceControls();
    syncConfidenceControls();

    if (ciState.sampleRecords.length >= ciState.numSamples) {
      renderConfidenceStatus();
      return;
    }

    appendConfidenceSample();
    ciState.autoTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
      const appended = appendConfidenceSample();
      if (!appended) {
        stopConfidenceAuto();
      }
    }, 320);
    renderConfidenceStatus();
  }

  function setConfidenceHoveredRecord(recordIndex) {
    const normalized = Number.isInteger(recordIndex) ? recordIndex : null;
    if (ciState.hoveredRecordIndex === normalized) return;
    ciState.hoveredRecordIndex = normalized;
    renderConfidenceMeansChart();
    renderConfidenceIntervalChart();
  }

  function positionConfidenceTooltip(event) {
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("ci-hover-tooltip");
    if (!tooltip) return;
    const tooltipWidth = tooltip.offsetWidth || 160;
    const tooltipHeight = tooltip.offsetHeight || 56;
    let left = event.clientX + 14;
    let top = event.clientY + 14;

    if (left + tooltipWidth > window.innerWidth - 12) {
      left = event.clientX - tooltipWidth - 14;
    }

    if (top + tooltipHeight > window.innerHeight - 12) {
      top = event.clientY - tooltipHeight - 14;
    }

    tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(12, left)}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(12, top)}px`;
  }

  function showConfidenceTooltip(event, recordIndex) {
    const record = ciState.sampleRecords[recordIndex];
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("ci-hover-tooltip");
    if (!record || !tooltip) return;
    const populationMeanObserved = ciState.populationValues.length ? average(ciState.populationValues) : record.populationMean;
    const populationSdObserved = ciState.populationValues.length ? standardDeviation(ciState.populationValues) : record.populationSd;
    const accumulatedMeans = ciState.sampleRecords.map((sampleRecord) => sampleRecord.mean);
    const accumulatedMeansSd = accumulatedMeans.length > 1 ? sampleStandardDeviation(accumulatedMeans) : 0;
    tooltip.innerHTML = [
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Promedio:</strong> ${formatStat(record.mean, 2)}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Desv. estándar muestral:</strong> ${formatStat(record.sampleSd, 2)}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Promedio poblacional:</strong> ${formatStat(populationMeanObserved, 2)}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Desv. estándar poblacional:</strong> ${formatStat(populationSdObserved, 2)}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Tamaño muestral (n):</strong> ${record.sampleSize}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>Error estándar (σ/√n):</strong> ${formatStat(record.theoreticalStandardError, 3)}</div>`,
      `<div class="tooltip-row"><strong>D.E. de los promedios acumulados:</strong> ${formatStat(accumulatedMeansSd, 3)}</div>`
    ].join("");
    tooltip.classList.add("visible");
    tooltip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    positionConfidenceTooltip(event);
  }

  function hideConfidenceTooltip() {
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("ci-hover-tooltip");
    if (!tooltip) return;
    tooltip.classList.remove("visible");
    tooltip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  }

  function hideConfidenceHover(shouldRender = true) {
    hideConfidenceTooltip();
    if (ciState.hoveredRecordIndex === null) return;
    ciState.hoveredRecordIndex = null;
    if (shouldRender) {
      renderConfidenceMeansChart();
      renderConfidenceIntervalChart();
    }
  }

  function handleConfidenceMeansPointerMove(event) {
    const target = event.target && typeof event.target.closest === "function"
      ? event.target.closest(".ci-mean-cell[data-record-index]")
      : null;

    if (!target) {
      hideConfidenceHover();
      return;
    }

    const recordIndex = Number(target.dataset.recordIndex);
    setConfidenceHoveredRecord(recordIndex);
    showConfidenceTooltip(event, recordIndex);
  }

  function handleConfidenceIntervalPointerMove(event) {
    const target = event.target && typeof event.target.closest === "function"
      ? event.target.closest(".ci-interval-record[data-record-index]")
      : null;

    if (!target) {
      hideConfidenceHover();
      return;
    }

    const recordIndex = Number(target.dataset.recordIndex);
    setConfidenceHoveredRecord(recordIndex);
    showConfidenceTooltip(event, recordIndex);
  }

  function initializeConfidenceIntervalsTab() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-ci-config-step]").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const input = document.getElementById(button.dataset.ciConfigTarget);
        const fallback = Number.parseInt(input.value, 10) || 0;
        input.value = fallback + Number.parseInt(button.dataset.ciConfigStep, 10);

        if (button.dataset.ciConfigTarget === "ci-pop-mean" || button.dataset.ciConfigTarget === "ci-pop-sd") {
          refreshConfidencePopulation(true);
        } else {
          readConfidenceControls();
          syncConfidenceControls();
          resetConfidenceSamples();
        }
      });
    });

    [
      ["ci-pop-mean", 30, -200, 200, true],
      ["ci-pop-sd", 12, 1, 80, true],
      ["ci-sample-size", 30, 2, 500, false],
      ["ci-num-samples", 40, 1, 400, false],
      ["ci-confidence-level", 95, 80, 99, false]
    ].forEach(([id, fallback, min, max, refreshPopulation]) => {
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        event.target.value = normalizeRandomInteger(event.target.value, fallback, min, max);
        if (refreshPopulation) {
          refreshConfidencePopulation(true);
        } else {
          readConfidenceControls();
          syncConfidenceControls();
          resetConfidenceSamples();
        }
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("ci-distribution-type").addEventListener("change", () => {
      refreshConfidencePopulation(true);
    });

    document.getElementById("ci-use-sample-sd").addEventListener("change", () => {
      readConfidenceControls();
      syncConfidenceControls();
      resetConfidenceSamples();
    });

    document.getElementById("ci-run-once").addEventListener("click", () => {
      stopConfidenceAuto();
      appendConfidenceSample();
    });
    document.getElementById("ci-run-auto").addEventListener("click", startConfidenceAuto);
    document.getElementById("ci-stop-auto").addEventListener("click", stopConfidenceAuto);

    const meansChart = document.getElementById("ci-means-hist-chart");
    meansChart.addEventListener("pointermove", handleConfidenceMeansPointerMove);
    meansChart.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
      hideConfidenceHover();
    });

    const intervalChart = document.getElementById("ci-interval-chart");
    intervalChart.addEventListener("pointermove", handleConfidenceIntervalPointerMove);
    intervalChart.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
      hideConfidenceHover();
    });

    readConfidenceControls();
    syncConfidenceControls();
    generateConfidencePopulationValues();
    renderConfidencePopulationChart();
    renderConfidenceMeansChart();
    renderConfidenceIntervalChart();
    renderConfidenceStatus();
  }

  function runSample(sampleSize) {
    const input = document.getElementById("m-input");
    state.m = normalizeM(input.value);
    input.value = state.m;
    hideSampleHover(false);

    const caseItem = makeCase(sampleSize, state.m);
    state.selectedN = sampleSize;
    state.rowResults.set(sampleSize, caseItem);
    state.cases.unshift(caseItem);
    saveCases();
    renderButtons();
    renderChart();
  }

  function resetChart() {
    const input = document.getElementById("m-input");
    state.m = normalizeM(input.value);
    input.value = state.m;
    hideSampleHover(false);
    state.selectedN = null;
    state.rowResults = new Map();
    state.cases = [];
    saveCases();
    renderButtons();
    renderChart();
  }

  function buildExportRows() {
    const orderedCases = [...state.cases].sort((a, b) => (a.caseNumber || 0) - (b.caseNumber || 0));
    const rows = [];

    orderedCases.forEach((caseItem) => {
      caseItem.means.forEach((meanValue, meanIndex) => {
        rows.push({
          case_number: caseItem.caseNumber || "",
          case_id: caseItem.id || "",
          created_at: caseItem.createdAt || "",
          sample_size_n: caseItem.sampleSize,
          num_samples_m: caseItem.numSamples,
          mean_index: meanIndex + 1,
          sample_mean: meanValue,
          grand_mean: caseItem.grandMean,
          population_mean: caseItem.populationMean,
          population_line_visible: caseItem.populationLineVisible ? "true" : "false"
        });
      });
    });

    return rows;
  }

  function escapeCsv(value) {
    const stringValue = String(value ?? "");
    if (/[",\n]/.test(stringValue)) {
      return `"${stringValue.replace(/"/g, "\"\"")}"`;
    }
    return stringValue;
  }

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? "")
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function triggerDownload(filename, content, mimeType) {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function downloadCsv() {
    const rows = buildExportRows();
    const headers = [
      "case_number",
      "case_id",
      "created_at",
      "sample_size_n",
      "num_samples_m",
      "mean_index",
      "sample_mean",
      "grand_mean",
      "population_mean",
      "population_line_visible"
    ];

    const csvLines = [
      headers.join(","),
      ...rows.map((row) => headers.map((header) => escapeCsv(row[header])).join(","))
    ];

    triggerDownload(
      "simulacion-muestreos-datos.csv",
      `\ufeff${csvLines.join("\n")}`,
      "text/csv;charset=utf-8;"
    );
  }

  function downloadExcel() {
    const rows = buildExportRows();
    const headers = [
      "case_number",
      "case_id",
      "created_at",
      "sample_size_n",
      "num_samples_m",
      "mean_index",
      "sample_mean",
      "grand_mean",
      "population_mean",
      "population_line_visible"
    ];

    const tableHead = headers.map((header) => `<th>${escapeHtml(header)}</th>`).join("");
    const tableBody = rows.map((row) => {
      const cells = headers.map((header) => `<td>${escapeHtml(row[header])}</td>`).join("");
      return `<tr>${cells}</tr>`;
    }).join("");

    const workbookHtml = [
      "<html>",
      "<head>",
      '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
      "<style>",
      "table { border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }",
      "th, td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 12px; }",
      "th { background: #d9eefb; }",
      "</style>",
      "</head>",
      "<body>",
      "<" + "table>",
      "<" + "thead><tr>" + tableHead + "</tr></thead>",
      "<" + "tbody>" + tableBody + "</tbody>",
      "</table>",
      "</body>",
      "</html>"
    ].join("");

    triggerDownload(
      "simulacion-muestreos-datos.xls",
      `\ufeff${workbookHtml}`,
      "application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8;"
    );
  }

  function setShowPopulationMean(nextValue) {
    state.showPopulationMean = nextValue;
    localStorage.setItem(SHOW_MEAN_STORAGE_KEY, String(nextValue));
    renderMeanToggle();
    renderChart();
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    loadState();
    initializeRandomSamplingTab();
    initializeConfidenceIntervalsTab();

    document.getElementById("m-input").value = state.m;

    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveTab(button.dataset.tab));
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".size-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => runSample(Number.parseInt(button.dataset.sampleSize, 10)));
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".step-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const input = document.getElementById("m-input");
        const nextValue = normalizeM(input.value) + Number.parseInt(button.dataset.step, 10);
        input.value = Math.max(1, nextValue);
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("m-input").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      event.target.value = normalizeM(event.target.value);
    });

    document.getElementById("download-csv").addEventListener("click", downloadCsv);
    document.getElementById("download-excel").addEventListener("click", downloadExcel);
    document.getElementById("reset-chart").addEventListener("click", resetChart);
    document.getElementById("population-mean-toggle").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      setShowPopulationMean(event.target.checked);
    });

    const meansChart = document.getElementById("means-chart");
    meansChart.addEventListener("pointermove", handleSampleChartPointerMove);
    meansChart.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
      hideSampleHover();
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => renderChart());
    });

    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", stopRandomSamplingAuto);
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", stopConfidenceAuto);

    setActiveTab(state.activeTab);
    renderButtons();
    renderMeanToggle();
    renderChart();
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => renderChart());
  });
</script>
```
